notes.title: Updata v2.2.0
notes.content:
Dear lords
We will carry out a shutdown maintenance which will be lasting for two hours on January 13 2021 at 10 to 12. You may not be able to log in the game during the process, and we feel sorry for the inconvenience. We have prepared research gift bags(3) for you as compensation reward after the maintenance is done.

The research gift bag and reward for teachers can be used in Monarch-treasury after you receive them. Please archive timely to avoid the lose. 

【Newly adjustment and upgrading】

1. The offspring system has been adjusted
A. The skills taught by the teachers is decreased from 4 to 2 and the left two skills will be taught by the father or mother.
B. After the offspring find the teacher, you cannot change the person who will teach.
C. Newly added prop “reward for teachers”: with the use of this prop you can change another teacher. You can purchase it in the market or obtain it in the search and visit mission. You don’t need to change the teacher through dismissing or death.
2. We added network environment Icon in the internal affairs and battlefield interface.
3. We have adjusted the one soldier system, which now has significantly reduced damage. ( the developers thought that the one soldier system is a brilliant tactic and should be promoted to use. However, some of the players believed that this is not logical and reasonable, and defined it as BUG. As a result, the developers adjusted it: when the troops are under 500, the damage will be reduced significantly.
4. Newly added prop Soul Cleaning Medical Powder: the legendary medicine that could heal all diseases immediately after taking it. It is available in the market.
5. Newly added prop life continuation potion: it could increase the lifespan of generals three years longer. This potion can be used five times in a lifetime and is obtained in the tomb robbing.
6. Newly added prop fairy dew； it could increase the lifespan of generals ten years longer. The fairy dew has no usage limit and is obtained in the tomb robbing.
7. We have revised the lifespan rules of generals. Generals will surely die in the year of their doom.(the month could be revised in S/L)
One year before the death, the generals will tell the player that they are near their end of the life.(I am going to die... give me the medicine!) P.S immortal mode will not be effected
8. We have adjusted the binding condition, icon and name of some props.
9. Now you can turn on/off the battle voice in the setting.
10. Now you will see the notice about archive and prop loses when you receive the email or use the account binding props in the treasury.
11. We added setting option in the function of the battle interface. You can set up sound effects, music and voice after you update the game.
12. We added the illustration of the upper limit of some props.
13. We added automatic appointment and removal function and one click title clear function.
14. We added the function to make the generals out of office to be the king, and the generals out of office in the empty city will set up a new force by themselves.
15. We added the keep on research button in the research result interface.
16. We added the full open with one click function to the props in the treasury.
17. The food in the game was replaced by army provisions


【optimization and repair】
1. We have adjusted the single pick fight, and now you can set up to directly pass the single pick fight process(no effect on the result)
2. We have adjusted the wrong description of the relationship between some generals and their sons
3. We have repaired the errors that made Zhang He(郃) mistakenly written as Zhang He(合）
4. We have repaired the text errors that occurred in the personal anecdote of Zhang Liao.
5. We have repaired an error in the mismatched terrain in Luo Yang
6. We have repaired the text errors in the biography of Liu Zan.
7. We have repaired the text errors occurred in the personal anecdote of Qu Yi.
8. We have repaired the wrong spelling in the tips.
9. We have repaired the error that makes you automatically choose a profile that already has been used when you made the self-built generals.
10. We have repaired the error that makes generals replace their treasure when the city they occupied is also the place where they carry out the search and visit mission.
11. We have repaired the error that makes the captures become the subordinates when they are disposed.
12. We have repaired the error that makes the wrong dialog in the personal anecdote of Yuan Shu.
13. We have optimized the profiles of some offspring.
14. We have optimized the confirm interface when the single pick fight is triggered. And now you can see the rules of single pick fight here.
15. We have optimized the interface of emails and noticeboard.
16. We have optimized the interface of generals who run for shelter. After the upgrading you can see the information of the generals who run for shelter.
17. We have optimized the immortal function, and now when the new script is unlocked, the setting will be the default numerical value which will be the same as last time.
18. We have repaired the error that makes you unable to choose more than nine generals in the attribute and array interface in the process of self-built generals.
19. We have repaired the error that makes it unable to select the self-built force
20. We have repaired the error that makes the celebrities appear in the wrong places during the search and visit mission.
21. We have repaired the error that caused the wrong statics after you have owned more than fifteen self-built female generals.
22. We have repaired the error that makes it unable to replace successfully after you choose to 
change the target city in the coordinated attack.
23. We have repaired the abnormal statics errors in the battlefield.
PS: all the revision about the general statics(attribute or skills) will be available after you reopen the edition.

Thank you for your understanding and supporting!

《Rise of Three Kingdoms》 Operation team

notes.title: v2.0.0 Update notification
notes.content:
Dear lord

We expect to have a two-hour shutdown for update maintenance from 2:00-4:00 UTC on December 29, 2020. During the maintenance period, you will not be able to log in to the game. We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

【Newly added and adjusted content】
Belle of War DLC is added, and you can also unlock the marriage, offspring, self-built female general and search and visit mission functions.
1. Marriage: through “monarch- bestow marriage” the king or the subordinates can get married with the opposite sex character. The couple in a marital relationship is less likely to be employed by the other states and there is chance to trigger the assist shooting.
2. Connection through marriage: through “diplomacy- connection through marriage” you can have marital relationship. After the successful marriage, the female side will join the male side and the covenant between two nations will last for 60 months.
3. Give birth and raise: only the monarch could have children. You can cultivate the offspring and the father and the teacher are important for the skill learning of the children. Heirs could even learn skills like Lianzhu or heart capture.
4. Self-built female generals: when you create the generals you can choose the gender of them.

5. Visit and search mission: you can send troops to carry out one-year-long visit and search mission. There is chance to meet the celebrities, explore the ancient tomb or experience special events. Attributes could be increased when meeting with celebrities, as high as 100. And tomb exploration may bring back with various items.

6. Added item: item “ Duke Lu’s secret note”, which can be used to replace 1000 gold during the research and development process. You can use only one of this for each time. It can also be obtained through market or the visit and search mission.
7. Added item: antiques, which can be used to improve the contribution when you go to the court. It can be obtained through market.
8. Added item: cyan shaft carriage, which can exempt gold for search and visit mission for once. It can be obtained through market or search and visit mission.

9. Added item: single shaft carriage. You can have as many as three heirs. If you find any of them is not talented enough you can send this one back to the hometown with carriages. And this won’t seize a seat of the offspring-_-|||. This item can be obtained through market.

10. Added item: leadership classics, force classics, intelligence classics, political classics and affinity classics. During the period of cultivating the heirs, you can improve the abilities of them with the help of the items above but within the limit. The classics can be obtained through market or visit and search mission.
11. Added item: rare secret book: leadership, rare secret book: force value, rare secret book: intelligence, rare secret book: politics, rare secret book: affinity. They can be used for generals with according attributes between 95 and 99 and improve their abilities with one point. They can be obtained through visit and search mission.
12. Added item: scroll fragment of war, scroll fragment of pugilistic, scroll fragment of music score, scroll fragment of scripts. Generals with serve skills can exchange them for rare secret book with celebrities during the visit and search mission. They can be obtained through market or visit and search mission.
13. Added item: tomb robbing charm, hair mound seal. They both could provide skill tomb robbing.
14. Added item: geography section, Yugong region map, water classics. They both could provide skill travelling.
15. Added item: cyan Inkstone, which could provide skill courtesy+appease+capable official. The treasure could only be obtained through tomb robbing.
16. Added item: the classic of mountains and rivers, which could provide skill ancient visit+ tomb robbing. The treasure could be obtained only through tomb robbing.
17. Added item: Wei’s shooting method, which could provide skill assist shooting. The treasure could be obtained only through tomb robbing.
18. Added item: Analects of Confucius, which could provide the skill appease. The treasure could be obtained only through tomb robbing. 
19. Added item: Teaching of Mencius, which could provide skill effulgent. The treasure could be obtained only through tomb robbing.
20. Added item: travelling, which could improve the efficiency of visit and search and reduce four months(default value: six months) of the time for the search and visit mission. 
21. Added item: ancient visit, which reduce three months of the time for getting the report of search and visit mission. It could also cover the effect of travelling.
22. Added item: tomb robbing, which could help you search the treasure you found in the search and visit mission.
23. Added skill: serve, with which you can serve the celebrities in the search and visit mission and get reward.
Optimization and repair
1. Change the number of the generals you can send to the battlefield from 10 to 20.
2. Change the market and you can buy more stuff now.
3. Now the secret gift, fairy blossom and advanced skill treasure chest could provide orders and assist shooting skills probably.
4. Now you could have healing and generals skills during the research and development process.
5. We have adjusted the skills of Zhong Yao, Pei Xiu, Yin Mo and sun Xiu and made them have tomb robbing skill and search and visit skill.
6. We have adjusted the skills of Yang Song, Yang Bo, Huang Hao and Cen Hun and made them have serve skill. And the initial loyalty of Yang Bo has been lowered.(I bet you know what this means...)
7. We repaired the position errors in the battlefield.
8. We repaired the excessive amount of treatment with the use of healing skill.(thanks to 张琪Zhangqi again!)
9. We repaired the incorrect description of Reputation in the dictionary.(thanks to 一目四行Yimushihang again!)
10. We repaired the errors of spiritual mechanism skill of Wei Rui in the main script.(thans to 归来Guilai again!)
11. We repaired the errors of the prompt message appeared after the changing speed in the battlefield had been adjusted .(thanks to 大佬 Dalao!)
12. There have been several errors about the optimize records that cannot be saved.
(the errors that records that cannot be saved were caused by other system errors. We are trying to solve these problems, and because of the complexity of the problem, we need some time as we are actively following up with it.) 
13. We adjusted and optimized the text, interface and settings of the system and the skills of some certain items.
PS: the modifies towards generals data(attribute and skills) will be available after we release the next edition.

notes.title: Rise of the three kingdoms The Belle of War edition Notice
notes.content:
Hello guys. I am one of the producers of Buwu Three Kingdoms, Nainiu. The game has been put on Steam for more than a week, and we have collected many suggestions provided by players. We cherish your opinion no matter what it may seem like. Today we would like to talk about our recent plan and the development of the game with you.

Firstly, let’s talk about the suggestions we received recently.

1. Some players have met with network delay problems after the game was launched. We will optimize the network within the week and make sure every one of you could have better experience.
2. Some customers said they have problems in loading the program. We have submitted a new client version to collect error logs. Such problem will reappear with an error box so that you can click to submit it.
3. For the translation errors with English and Korean, we have contacted with more professional agencies to solve the problems. It requires a period until the problem will be completely solved since the there are a large amount of tasks.

The next is about our follow up development planning
We will offer the first large edition, Belle of War(including marriage, breeding, self-built female generals and search and visit missions), which will be free to unlock. The details:

1. Marriage: through monarch-grant marriage you can make the monarch or the subordinates to get married. The couples may be less likely to be employed by another state and could trigger the assist shooting in the battlefield.

2. Connections through marriages: obtained through diplomacy-connections through marriages. You can choose either marry or to be married. After the successful connections through marriages, the female side will join the male side and the covenant between countries will last for 50 months.

4. Having child&breeding: only the monarch could have children. You can nurse the child and educate them, and father and teachers have greater impact on the skill learning of the offspring. The offspring could even learn skills like Lianzhu or Heart Capture.

5. Self-built female generals: you can chose the gender of the generals when you are creating them.


6. Search and visit mission: you can send subordinates to carry out search and visit mission for one year. You may meet with celebrities and have chances to explore ancient tombs or experience special events. You can increase the attributes when you meet celebrities, and it could reach 100. You can bring back various items form the tombs as well.

In the following 2021, new strategy system, vassal state system(including legion and commission), city construction, general skills, arm of services(including special arms), emperor control and the hell difficulty are all in line for development. Please wait for that!
Finally, we really want to make the game better with the help of you guys! Leave anything you want to say or share through the contact information below:Email slgamemails@gmail.com
